create_SIREN_network: create a SIREN neural network with sine activations and specified layer widths for continuous representation learning
build_SINESmearing_basis: build a SINESmearing module that applies exponential frequency sine encoding to input features for basis expansion
create_GaussianSmearing_basis: create a GaussianSmearing module that applies Gaussian radial basis functions to input features with configurable range
build_FourierSmearing_basis: build a FourierSmearing module that applies linear frequency sine or cosine encoding to input features
create_Basis_module: create a Basis module with configurable smearing type like powersine, gauss, or spherical harmonics for feature encoding
